mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_no, t.session_id, t.user_id, t.goal_type, t.goal_text, t.target_type, t.target_id, t.collection_task_id, t.species_id, t.status, t.current_phase, t.progress_percent, t.context_json, t.result_summary, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.version, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.start_time, t.finish_time, t.cancel_time, t.is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_agent_task ( task_no, session_id, user_id, goal_type, goal_text, target_type, target_id, collection_task_id, species_id, status, current_phase, progress_percent, context_json, result_summary, error_code, error_message, version, create_time, update_time, start_time, finish_time, cancel_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{taskNo}, #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{goalType}, #{goalText}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{collectionTaskId}, #{speciesId}, #{status}, #{currentPhase}, #{progressPercent}, #{contextJson}, #{resultSummary}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assistant_agent_task t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM assistant_agent_task t WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.current_phase = 'EVIDENCE_ANALYSIS_COMPLETED' AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assistant_agent_collection_plan p WHERE p.agent_task_id = t.id AND p.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PROPOSED', 'CONFIRMED') ) ORDER BY t.update_time, t.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM assistant_agent_task t LEFT JOIN herb_collection_task ct ON ct.id = t.collection_task_id AND ct.is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM assistant_agent_task t LEFT JOIN herb_collection_task ct ON ct.id = t.collection_task_id AND ct.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_agent_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, result_summary = COALESCE(#{resultSummary}, result_summary), start_time = COALESCE(start_time, #{startTime}), finish_time = COALESCE(#{finishTime}, finish_time), cancel_time = COALESCE(#{cancelTime}, cancel_time), update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE assistant_agent_task SET progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, current_phase = #{currentPhase}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND is_deleted = 0
